instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `flutter upgrade channel`.

instruction: How would you explain `fix cleartext http blocked` to a junior developer?

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `fix safearea double padding`?

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `fix stream listen twice`?

instruction: When do I use `system overlay statusbar`?

instruction: `impeller renderer` untuk apa?

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `orientation lock widgets`.
output: `SystemChrome.setPreferredOrientations([DeviceOrientation.portraitUp])` in `main` (!) — `await` it before `runApp` for a choppy-free start; per-page re-lock for video pages (landscape!).

instruction: When do I use `google sign in`?
output: `GoogleSignIn().signIn()` -> `GoogleSignInAuthentication` -> `GoogleAuthProvider.credential(idToken:! accessToken:!)` for Firebase (!) — SHA-1 fingerprint must be registered for Android, or `ApiException: 10` (!).

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `adaptive widgets ios`.

instruction: Explain `image picker camera gallery` briefly.

instruction: Terangkan `fix setstate after dispose` secara ringkas.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `localization arb setup`?

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `go_router redirect auth`.
output: `redirect: (_, state) => isLoggedIn ? null : '/login'` with `refreshListenable: auth` (!) — runs on every navigation when auth notifies; `state.matchedLocation` keeps the intended target for post-login return.

instruction: When do I use `maps google_maps_flutter`?
output: `GoogleMap(initialCameraPosition: CameraPosition(target: LatLng(3.14, 101.69), zoom: 15), markers: {...})` (!) — needs API keys per platform (Android metadata! iOS `AppDelegate`!) or the map renders grey; `onMapCreated` to move camera programmatically.

instruction: When do I use `navigator push pop`?

instruction: Bila perlu guna `fix firestore offline empty`?

instruction: Explain `rebuild relayout repaint` briefly.
output: Flutter pipeline: rebuild (widget!) -> relayout (render!) -> repaint (paint!) (!) — `setState` alone triggers rebuild subtree, `RepaintBoundary` isolates paint, `const` widgets stop rebuild propagation early.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `fix unbounded height listview`.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `form validation global key`?

instruction: Explain `container decoration padding` briefly.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `fcm notification handle`?

instruction: When do I use `profile mode timing`?

instruction: Give a practical example of `fix stream listen twice`.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `fix android exported required`?

instruction: How would you explain `bottomsheet showmodal` to a junior developer?

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `rebuild relayout repaint`.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `fix adb device offline`.

instruction: Give a practical example of `hot reload vs restart`.
output: Hot reload (`r`!) re-injects code keeping state (fast UI tweak!) — hot restart (`R`) resets state and re-runs `main` (!); neither re-runs `initState` on reload, so stashed flags survive unexpectedly.

instruction: Give a practical example of `dio vs http`.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `page transitions custom`?
output: `PageRouteBuilder(transitionsBuilder: (_, a, __, child) => FadeTransition(opacity: a, child: child), transitionDuration: 200ms)` (!) — `theme.pageTransitionsTheme` sets app-wide defaults per platform.

instruction: How would you explain `isolate long lived` to a junior developer?
output: `Isolate.spawn(entry, msg)` + `SendPort`/`ReceivePort` for a worker that outlives one task (!) — `Isolate.run` covers one-shot; keep messages small (copied!) and handle spawn errors (`onError`!).

instruction: Apakah fungsi `fix cleartext http blocked`?
output: Android 9+ blocks plain `http://` (!) — use https, or `android:usesCleartextTraffic='true'`/`network_security_config` for dev; iOS needs `NSAppTransportSecurity` exceptions (both are store-review smells if shipped!).

instruction: Bagaimanakah `gradle jdk mismatch` berfungsi?
output: `Unsupported class file major version` / DSL errors = JDK vs Gradle mismatch (!) — set `org.gradle.java.home` or `flutter config --jdk-dir`, update `distributionUrl` in `gradle-wrapper.properties`; Android Studio bundles the JDK.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `theme themedata colortheme`?

instruction: What is `pull to refresh web` for?
output: On web/desktop, pull-to-refresh is odd (!) — gate `RefreshIndicator` behind `defaultTargetPlatform` checks or provide a refresh button (!); `ScrollConfiguration` to disable glow/overscroll effects per platform.

instruction: Give a practical example of `fix duplicate globalkey`.
output: `Multiple widgets used the same GlobalKey` (!) — a `GlobalKey` instance may only exist at one spot at a time; create keys per item (`GlobalKey<FormState>()` per form!), not as shared statics.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `fix timer after dispose`?
output: Timers/animations keep running offscreen = battery + `setState after dispose` crashes (!) — keep a `List<Timer>` or single `_t`, `cancel()` in `dispose`; same for `StreamSubscription` and `AnimationController`.

instruction: Bagaimanakah `keys global vs value` berfungsi?
output: `ValueKey(id)` tells Flutter which list items are the same across rebuilds (! reorder animation correct!) — `GlobalKey` (single widget! survives reparent!) reaches a widget's state (`key.currentState!`) used sparingly (! it disables some optimizations).

instruction: What problem does `tabbar tabcontroller` solve?
output: `DefaultTabController(length: 3, child: Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(bottom: TabBar(tabs: [...])), body: TabBarView(children: [...])))` (!) — for manual control use `TabController` + `SingleTickerProviderStateMixin`.

instruction: What problem does `ci codemagic github` solve?
output: Codemagic/GitHub Actions: `flutter pub get` -> `flutter analyze` -> `flutter test` -> `flutter build apk --release` with `subosito/flutter-action` (!) — cache `~/.pub-cache` and Gradle; store secrets (keystore pwd!) in CI secrets.

instruction: What problem does `listview builder lazy` solve?
output: `ListView.builder` builds items lazily on scroll (`itemBuilder`! `itemCount`!) — never `ListView(children: [...])` for long/computed lists (!); `ListView.separated` adds dividers, `shrinkWrap` is a perf trap in scrollables.

instruction: Explain `go_router redirect auth` briefly.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `freezed models`?

instruction: Terangkan `debugprint vs print` dalam satu minit.
output: `debugPrint` throttles output so logcat/console does not drop lines (!) — both stripped semantics aside; `print` in loops can overflow the console buffer, prefer `debugPrint`/`log` in debug builds.

instruction: Terangkan `secure storage tokens` secara ringkas.

instruction: Terangkan `flutter performance default` secara ringkas.
output: Perf defaults in order: `const` widgets, `ListView.builder`, sized images (`cacheWidth`), avoid `Opacity`/`ClipPath` in lists, defer heavy initial work (`scheduler` idle!) (!) — measure in `--profile` before and after any optimization.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `hero animation tag`?

instruction: Terangkan `fix pub cache corrupt` dalam satu minit.

instruction: Give a practical example of `provider multiprovider tree`.

instruction: Give a practical example of `fix scrollcontroller not attached`.

instruction: Give a practical example of `listview itemextent`.

instruction: Terangkan `bottomnavigationbar pages` dalam satu minit.

instruction: What is `container decoration padding` for?

instruction: When do I use `dio vs http`?

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `fix missingplugin exception`.

output: `GestureDetector(onPanUpdate: (d) => offset += d.delta, onPanEnd: snap!)` (!) — `onTap`/`onDoubleTap`/`onLongPress` same widget; `behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque` captures empty areas (transparent backgrounds miss taps!).

instruction: What does `geolocator stream` do?
output: `Geolocator.getPositionStream(locationSettings: LocationSettings(accuracy: LocationAccuracy.high, distanceFilter: 10))` (!) — request `LocationPermission` first and branch permanentlyDenied; `getCurrentPosition` for one-shot with `timeLimit`.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `lottie animations`?
output: `Lottie.asset('assets/anim.json', controller: c, repeat: false)` (!) — After Effects JSON animations; `Lottie.network` for remote; heavy animations cost frames — prefer for empty states/success moments, not running forever.

instruction: Bagaimanakah `local notifications` berfungsi?
output: `flutter_local_notifications`: init with Android/macOS settings, `zonedSchedule(id, title, body, tz.TZDateTime, NotificationDetails, androidScheduleMode: exactAllowWhileIdle)` (!) — Android 13+ needs runtime POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission.

instruction: `fix firestore offline empty` untuk apa?
output: Offline first run shows nothing (!) — `get()` from cache returns empty without connectivity (!) — listen `snapshots().listen(source:!)`, use `Settings(persistenceEnabled: true)` check, and show `snapshot.metadata.isFromCache` states.

instruction: How would you explain `pull to refresh web` to a junior developer?
output: On web/desktop, pull-to-refresh is odd (!) — gate `RefreshIndicator` behind `defaultTargetPlatform` checks or provide a refresh button (!); `ScrollConfiguration` to disable glow/overscroll effects per platform.

instruction: When do I use `changenotifier notifylisteners`?
output: `class Cart extends ChangeNotifier { void add(x) { items.add(x); notifyListeners(); } }` (!) — listeners added by `watch`/`addListener` fire synchronously; `notifyListeners` after `dispose` throws, dispose with `super.dispose()`.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `profile mode timing`.
output: `flutter run --profile` (real perf!) vs `--release` (no tooling) (!) — never judge scrolling on debug builds (asserts + no AOT!); `flutter drive --profile --trace-startup` for cold-start timings.

instruction: What is `tween animation value` for?
output: `final a = Tween(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: ctrl, curve: Curves.easeOut))` (!) — drive anything with `AnimatedBuilder(animation: ctrl, builder:)`: sizes, colors, transforms.

instruction: Give a practical example of `material3 dynamic color`.
output: `ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: brand)` + `useMaterial3: true` (!) — `dynamic_color` package pulls Android 12+ wallpaper palette; keep brand fallback for platforms without dynamic color.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `google sign in`.
output: `GoogleSignIn().signIn()` -> `GoogleSignInAuthentication` -> `GoogleAuthProvider.credential(idToken:! accessToken:!)` for Firebase (!) — SHA-1 fingerprint must be registered for Android, or `ApiException: 10` (!).

instruction: What problem does `valuenotifier valuelistenablebuilder` solve?
output: `ValueNotifier<T>(0)` + `ValueListenableBuilder<T>(valueListenable: n, builder: (_, v, __) => Text('$v'))` (!) — the cheapest reactive primitive: no provider package, rebuilds only the builder, `n.value++` notifies.

instruction: What is `dialog showdialog alert` for?
output: `showDialog(context: context, builder: (_) => AlertDialog(title:!, content:!, actions: [TextButton(...)]))` (!) — returns a `Future` with the result of `Navigator.pop(context, value)`; barrier dismiss via `barrierDismissible`.

instruction: What problem does `snackbar scaffoldmessenger` solve?
output: `ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(SnackBar(content: Text('Disimpan')))` (!) — queues safely across routes; the old `Scaffold.of(context).showSnackBar` breaks when the scaffold is rebuilt away.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `platform channel method`?
output: `MethodChannel('app/native').invokeMethod<String>('getBattery')` <-> Kotlin `MethodChannel(flutterEngine.dartExecutor, 'app/native').setMethodCallHandler {}` (!) — names on both sides must match exactly or calls throw `MissingPluginException`.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `dependency overrides`?
output: `dependency_overrides` force versions for pub conflicts (!) — avoids resolver deadlocks short-term, but pins silently drift; prefer upgrading both packages, remove overrides once merged upstream.

instruction: Terangkan `streambuilder snapshot` dalam satu minit.
output: `StreamBuilder<T>(stream:!, builder:!)` rebuilds per event (`snapshot.data`! `hasError`! `connectionState`!) (!) — cancel/close the source stream in `dispose`/state or listeners stay alive after unmount.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `flutter everything is widget`?
output: In Flutter everything is a widget (Text! Container! Padding!) — the whole UI is a tree of immutable configs (!) rebuilt into elements/render objects; composition over inheritance, no XML layouts.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `freezed models`?
output: `@freezed class User with _$User { const factory User({required String name, @Default(0) int age}) = _User; }` (!) — copyWith/equality/toString generated; `@freezed` unions (sealed states!) model loading/error/data cleanly.

instruction: Bagaimanakah `fix proguard breaks plugin` berfungsi?
output: Reflection-based plugins crash only in release (!) — add `-keep class com.example.** { *; }` rules to `proguard-rules.pro` or set `minifyEnabled false` for that flavor while diagnosing.

instruction: Bagaimanakah `card listtile` berfungsi?
output: `Card(child: ListTile(leading:!, title:!, subtitle:!, trailing:!, onTap:!))` is the Material list idiom (!) — `ListTile.divideTiles`/`ListView.separated` draw separators; `Card` takes `elevation`/`shape`.

instruction: How would you explain `semantics labels screenreader` to a junior developer?
output: `Semantics(label: 'Tambah item', button: true, child: Icon(...))` (!) — TalkBack/VoiceOver read icons as nothing without it; `MergeSemantics` groups a card+title+subtitle into one announcement.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `fix font not applying`?
output: Custom font ignored (!) — family name in `pubspec` must match `fontFamily:` exactly (!), variable-font weight ranges need `weight:` entries; stale build -> `flutter clean`; missing glyphs silently fall back to default.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `navigator nested`?
output: Nested `Navigator` (with its own `GlobalKey<NavigatorState>`) keeps an inner stack alive (tab shells! bottom nav!) (!) — `WillPopScope`/`PopScope` on the shell decides if back pops the inner or outer stack.

instruction: What does `keys global vs value` do?
output: `ValueKey(id)` tells Flutter which list items are the same across rebuilds (! reorder animation correct!) — `GlobalKey` (single widget! survives reparent!) reaches a widget's state (`key.currentState!`) used sparingly (! it disables some optimizations).

instruction: Bila perlu guna `buildcontext location`?
output: `BuildContext` is the widget's slot in the tree — `Theme.of`/`Navigator.of`/`MediaQuery.of` all need the right context (!) — using the page's context for `showDialog` puts the dialog above the page, `context.mounted` after awaits.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `debugprint vs print`?
output: `debugPrint` throttles output so logcat/console does not drop lines (!) — both stripped semantics aside; `print` in loops can overflow the console buffer, prefer `debugPrint`/`log` in debug builds.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `getx controller rx`?
output: `class C extends GetxController { final n = 0.obs; }` + `Obx(() => Text('${c.n}'))` (!) — GetX bundles routing/di/i18n, but its magic globals hurt testability; fine for small apps, debated for large.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `fix keyboard overflow form`?
output: Keyboard pops -> bottom overflow (!) — wrap the form in `SingleChildScrollView` (`reverse: false`!) + Scaffold `resizeToAvoidBottomInset: true`; `SafeArea` + `padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom)`.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `const constructors perf`.
output: `const` widget instances are canonicalized and skipped during rebuilds (!) — `const Text('x')` beats `Text('x')`; let the IDE add `const` where possible, it is free performance.

instruction: Explain `obscured password toggle` briefly.
output: `obscureText: true` + suffix `IconButton(icon: Icon(show ? Icons.visibility_off : Icons.visibility), onPressed: () => setState(() => show = !show))` (!) — `obscuringCharacter: '*'` customizes the mask.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `popscope canpop`?
output: `PopScope(canPop: false, onPopInvokedWithResult: (didPop, _) { ... })` intercepts system back (!) — the old `WillPopScope` is deprecated; `canPop` false + manual `Navigator.pop` = confirm dialogs.

instruction: `flutter build apk release` untuk apa?
output: `flutter build apk --release` outputs `build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk` (!) — debug banner and asserts stripped; `--split-per-abi` builds arm64-v8a/armeabi-v7a separately (smaller downloads! Play wants AAB anyway).

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `materialpageroute transition`?
output: `MaterialPageRoute` gives platform transitions (`fullscreenDialog: true` slide-up for modals!) — custom motion needs `PageRouteBuilder` (`transitionsBuilder`! `transitionDuration`!) or `Hero` for shared-element jumps.

instruction: Give a practical example of `setstate vs provider`.
output: `setState` is fine for local/ephemeral UI (toggle! animation!) (!) — lift to `ChangeNotifier`/riverpod/bloc when siblings or routes need the same data; mixing both on one value invites double rebuilds.

instruction: What is `ci codemagic github` for?
output: Codemagic/GitHub Actions: `flutter pub get` -> `flutter analyze` -> `flutter test` -> `flutter build apk --release` with `subosito/flutter-action` (!) — cache `~/.pub-cache` and Gradle; store secrets (keystore pwd!) in CI secrets.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `safearea notches`?
output: `SafeArea` pads content away from notches/status bar/home indicator (!) — `SafeArea(top: false)` only when an `AppBar` already handles the top; `MediaQuery.paddingOf(context)` for manual math.

instruction: When do I use `scaffold appbar body fab`?
output: `Scaffold` gives the page skeleton (`appBar`! `body`! `floatingActionButton`! `bottomNavigationBar`! `drawer`!) — one per route; `Scaffold.of(context)` reaches the nearest one (! context must be below!).

instruction: `firestore listen snapshot` untuk apa?
output: `FirebaseFirestore.instance.collection('todos').snapshots().listen((snap) => ...)` (!) — realtime pushes per change; `.get()` is one-shot; model `snap.docs.map((d) => Todo.fromJson(d.data()..['id'] = d.id))` (id lives outside data!).

instruction: What is `flavor dev prod` for?
output: Flavors: `flutter build apk --flavor prod -t lib/main_prod.dart` (!) — Android: `productFlavors` in `android/app/build.gradle` (`applicationIdSuffix '.dev'`!); iOS: Xcode schemes with matching names (must match exactly!).

instruction: When do I use `fix context after await`?
output: `Don't use BuildContext across async gaps` lint is real (!) — after any `await`: `if (!context.mounted) return;` before `Navigator`/`Theme.of` calls, or capture `ScaffoldMessenger.of(context)` BEFORE the await.

instruction: Explain `streambuilder snapshot` briefly.
output: `StreamBuilder<T>(stream:!, builder:!)` rebuilds per event (`snapshot.data`! `hasError`! `connectionState`!) (!) — cancel/close the source stream in `dispose`/state or listeners stay alive after unmount.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `fix tabbar length mismatch`.
output: `Controller's length property does not match the number of tabs` (!) — `DefaultTabController(length: n)`/`TabController(length: n)` must equal `tabs.length` AND `TabBarView.children.length` (!) — the classic off-by-one after adding a tab.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `rebuild relayout repaint`.
output: Flutter pipeline: rebuild (widget!) -> relayout (render!) -> repaint (paint!) (!) — `setState` alone triggers rebuild subtree, `RepaintBoundary` isolates paint, `const` widgets stop rebuild propagation early.

instruction: Explain `fix app icon not updating` briefly.
output: Icon change invisible (!) — OS caches launcher icons: uninstall the app (launcher cache!), check every mipmap density (icon may be stale at only one size!), rebranded launcher may need a device restart.

instruction: Terangkan `fix adb device offline` secara ringkas.
output: `device offline`/missing (!) — `adb kill-server && adb start-server` (!), re-authorize USB debugging on the phone popup, `flutter devices` refresh; wireless debugging pairing resets after reboot.

instruction: Terangkan `container decoration padding` dalam satu minit.
output: `Container` combines sizing (`width/height`), `padding`, `margin`, `decoration` (`BoxDecoration`: `color`! `borderRadius`! `boxShadow`!) and alignment — heavy if nested deep (!); prefer `SizedBox`/`Padding` alone when you only need one property.

instruction: Terangkan `animatedcontainer implicit` secara ringkas.
output: `AnimatedContainer(duration: 300ms, width: _w, color: _c)` animates property changes automatically (!) — the whole implicit family: `AnimatedOpacity`! `AnimatedPadding`! `AnimatedSwitcher`! no controller needed.

instruction: When do I use `fix code signing ios`?
output: `Runner requires a development team` (!) — select a team in Xcode Signing & Capabilities, let it manage certificates, `flutter clean` after changing bundle id (!); CI needs the cert + provisioning profile installed.

instruction: Terangkan `flutter doctor setup` secara ringkas.

instruction: Explain `fix text ellipsis` briefly.

instruction: What does `signing keystore` do?
output: `keytool -genkey -v -keystore upload.jks -keyalg RSA -validity 10000` then `key.properties` (gitignored!) + `signingConfigs.release` in gradle (!) — losing the key means you can never update the Play listing.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `fix proguard breaks plugin`.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `devtools performance`.

instruction: `fix correct dark mode testing suite` untuk apa?

instruction: Bila perlu guna `fix dark mode invisible text`?
output: Hardcoded `Colors.black87` text vanishes on dark backgrounds (!) — use `Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface` (!); `ThemeMode.system` testing on both modes early prevents the audit later.

instruction: How would you explain `fix min sdk version error` to a junior developer?
output: `uses-sdk:minSdkVersion 21 cannot be smaller than version 24` — a plugin raised the floor (!) — set `minSdkVersion 24` in `android/app/build.gradle`/`flutter.minSdkVersion` and accept dropping old devices (or pin the plugin lower!).

instruction: Terangkan `fix gradle daemon memory` dalam satu minit.

instruction: Terangkan `flutter performance default` dalam satu minit.
output: Perf defaults in order: `const` widgets, `ListView.builder`, sized images (`cacheWidth`), avoid `Opacity`/`ClipPath` in lists, defer heavy initial work (`scheduler` idle!) (!) — measure in `--profile` before and after any optimization.

instruction: Terangkan `refreshing pull` dalam satu minit.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `screenutil vs mediaquery`.
output: `flutter_screenutil` scales via design size (`ScreenUtilInit(designSize: Size(375, 812))` + `.w/.h/.sp`!) — convenient but fights accessibility font scaling (!) — prefer `MediaQuery` + `LayoutBuilder` for real responsivity.

output: Network `SocketException` on Android release but works in debug = missing `INTERNET` permission (!) — add it to `AndroidManifest.xml`; debug builds merge it automatically, which masks the bug until release.

instruction: When do I use `splash screen native`?
output: `flutter_native_splash` generates native launch screens (Android 12 stretch! iOS storyboard!) from one image + brand color (!) — real native logo before Flutter boots; the Dart splash is only for after-run preload.

instruction: How would you explain `fix duplicate globalkey` to a junior developer?
output: `Multiple widgets used the same GlobalKey` (!) — a `GlobalKey` instance may only exist at one spot at a time; create keys per item (`GlobalKey<FormState>()` per form!), not as shared statics.

output: Resolver keeps stale picks (!) — `flutter pub upgrade --major-versions` or delete `pubspec.lock` and `pub get` (apps should commit lock!) — `flutter pub outdated` shows who lags.

instruction: `pageview carousel` untuk apa?
output: `PageView(controller: _pc, onPageChanged: (i) => setState(...), children: [...])` (!) — `viewportFraction: 0.9` peeks neighbors; combine with `dots_indicator` or an `AnimatedContainer` dot row (dots animate with page!).

instruction: What problem does `fix white screen release` solve?

instruction: `page transitions custom` untuk apa?

instruction: Give a practical example of `gridview builder crosscount`.

instruction: How would you explain `fix animationcontroller vsync` to a junior developer?
output: `AnimationController` throws without a `TickerProvider` (!) — mix in `SingleTickerProviderStateMixin` (one controller!) / `TickerProviderStateMixin` (many!); `vsync: this` typo = compile error with hints.

instruction: What does `fix timer after dispose` do?
output: Timers/animations keep running offscreen = battery + `setState after dispose` crashes (!) — keep a `List<Timer>` or single `_t`, `cancel()` in `dispose`; same for `StreamSubscription` and `AnimationController`.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `signing keystore`?
output: `keytool -genkey -v -keystore upload.jks -keyalg RSA -validity 10000` then `key.properties` (gitignored!) + `signingConfigs.release` in gradle (!) — losing the key means you can never update the Play listing.

instruction: When do I use `file picker package`?
output: `FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.custom, allowedExtensions: ['pdf'])` (!) — returns `FilePickerResult?.files.first.path`; on Android 13+ SAF URIs may need `readAsBytes` instead of File paths.

instruction: Give a practical example of `platform channel method`.
output: `MethodChannel('app/native').invokeMethod<String>('getBattery')` <-> Kotlin `MethodChannel(flutterEngine.dartExecutor, 'app/native').setMethodCallHandler {}` (!) — names on both sides must match exactly or calls throw `MissingPluginException`.

instruction: Explain `image asset network` briefly.
output: `Image.asset('assets/logo.png')` needs the folder declared in `pubspec.yaml` (`flutter: assets:`) (!) — `Image.network` caches via `ImageCache`; both accept `fit: BoxFit.cover` (`width/height`! `errorBuilder`!).

instruction: Bila perlu guna `flutter test golden ci`?
output: Golden tests fail on CI due to font rendering differences (!) — run goldens in the same container/SDK as generation or skip them in CI (!); they catch layout regressions across spacing/theme changes.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `provider multi select watch`?
output: `context.watch<Cart>()` (rebuild on any change!) vs `context.select<Cart, int>((c) => c.count)` (rebuild only when that value changes!) (!) — `read` inside callbacks avoids subscribing.

instruction: Explain `focusnode next field` briefly.
output: `FocusNode` per field + `textInputAction: TextInputAction.next` and `onSubmitted: (_) => FocusScope.of(context).nextFocus()` (!) — dispose nodes; `autofocus: true` on the first field of a form screen.

instruction: `textfield controller onchanged` untuk apa?
output: `TextField(controller: ctrl)` for read/write text, `onChanged`/`onSubmitted` for events (!) — dispose controllers (!); `TextEditingController.text` set inside `initState` with `ctrl.text = 'x'` (selection resets otherwise).

instruction: Terangkan `navigator nested` secara ringkas.
output: Nested `Navigator` (with its own `GlobalKey<NavigatorState>`) keeps an inner stack alive (tab shells! bottom nav!) (!) — `WillPopScope`/`PopScope` on the shell decides if back pops the inner or outer stack.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `mocktail mock`?
output: `class MockApi extends Mock implements Api {}` + `when(() => api.get()).thenAnswer((_) async => [])` (!) — mocktail needs no codegen; `verify(() => api.get()).called(1)` asserts interactions in unit tests.

instruction: What is `flutter upgrade channel` for?
output: `flutter channel stable` + `flutter upgrade` (!) — stable for shipping, beta for previews; `fvm` pins per-project SDK (!) — upgrade early in a cycle, not the day before release (plugin breakage!).

instruction: What is `listview itemextent` for?
output: `ListView.builder(itemExtent: 72)` lets the viewport skip layout math for offscreen items (!) — big win on long fixed-height lists; variable heights need `prototypeItem` instead.

instruction: Explain `cupertino widgets` briefly.
output: `CupertinoApp/CupertinoPageScaffold/CupertinoNavigationBar/CupertinoButton` mirror iOS (!) — `CupertinoTabScaffold` for tab bars; mixing Material and Cupertino needs a per-platform theme decision early.

instruction: What is `fix asset not found` for?
output: `Unable to load asset: assets/img/x.png` (!) — path mismatch: folders do NOT recurse, declare `assets/img/` or each file; `flutter clean` + rebuild when pubspec changed (stale asset bundle!).

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `geolocator stream`.
output: `Geolocator.getPositionStream(locationSettings: LocationSettings(accuracy: LocationAccuracy.high, distanceFilter: 10))` (!) — request `LocationPermission` first and branch permanentlyDenied; `getCurrentPosition` for one-shot with `timeLimit`.

instruction: Terangkan `launcher icons package` dalam satu minit.
output: `flutter_launcher_icons` (`flutter_launcher_icons.yaml` with 1024px source!) then `dart run flutter_launcher_icons` (!) — generates every mipmap/AppIcon size; `adaptive_icon_background` for Android 8+ masks.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `equatable equality`?
output: `class User extends Equatable { @override List<Object?> get props => [id, name]; }` (!) — without value equality, `BlocBuilder` and `setState` diffing treat equal states as changed (extra rebuilds!) or vice versa.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `fix keyboard overflow form`.
output: Keyboard pops -> bottom overflow (!) — wrap the form in `SingleChildScrollView` (`reverse: false`!) + Scaffold `resizeToAvoidBottomInset: true`; `SafeArea` + `padding: EdgeInsets.only(bottom: MediaQuery.viewInsetsOf(context).bottom)`.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `audio just_audio`.
output: `AudioPlayer()..setUrl(url)..play()` with `player.positionStream`/`durationStream` (!) — `just_audio` ships gapless/playlists; combine with `audio_service` for lockscreen controls (foreground service permissions!).

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `tabbar tabcontroller`?
output: `DefaultTabController(length: 3, child: Scaffold(appBar: AppBar(bottom: TabBar(tabs: [...])), body: TabBarView(children: [...])))` (!) — for manual control use `TabController` + `SingleTickerProviderStateMixin`.

instruction: Terangkan `google sign in` dalam satu minit.
output: `GoogleSignIn().signIn()` -> `GoogleSignInAuthentication` -> `GoogleAuthProvider.credential(idToken:! accessToken:!)` for Firebase (!) — SHA-1 fingerprint must be registered for Android, or `ApiException: 10` (!).

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `provider multiprovider tree`?
output: `MultiProvider(providers: [ChangeNotifierProvider(...), Provider(...)], child: App())` (!) — order matters: a provider cannot read one declared after it; `ProxyProvider` derives one model from another.

instruction: When do I use `app review update flow`?
output: Store updates: bump `version: x.y.z+n`, build AAB/IPA, upload, staged rollout (!) — Play console review 1-7 days for new permissions; TestFlight external needs review too; keep a changelog (`--build-name` in CI!).

instruction: What does `fix future already completed` do?
output: `Future already completed` / double-resolve (!) — completers resolved twice by retry logic; guard with a `bool _done` or use `Completer.sync`; also `RefreshIndicator` firing during an active load.

instruction: Give a practical example of `profile mode timing`.
output: `flutter run --profile` (real perf!) vs `--release` (no tooling) (!) — never judge scrolling on debug builds (asserts + no AOT!); `flutter drive --profile --trace-startup` for cold-start timings.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `datepicker showdatepicker`.
output: `showDatePicker(context:!, initialDate:!, firstDate: DateTime(2000), lastDate: DateTime(2100))` returns `Future<DateTime?>` (!) — format for display with `intl` `DateFormat('dd/MM/yyyy')` (`initializeDateFormatting` for locales!).

instruction: When do I use `refreshing pull`?
output: `RefreshIndicator(onRefresh: _load, child: ListView(...))` (!) — `_load` must return a `Future` that completes when done, or the spinner hangs; the list needs `AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics` for short content.

instruction: Terangkan `web build renderer` secara ringkas.
output: `flutter build web --release` (`--wasm` newer!) (!) — canvas renderer fights SEO/screenreaders (text is pixels in the DOM-less case!); `--base-href` for subpath hosting, caching via service worker.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `fix inkwell no ripple`?
output: Ripple missing (!) — no `Material` ancestor above the `InkWell` (!), or the splash paints BEHIND an opaque child (use `Ink`!); `Container(color:)` between Material and InkWell hides the splash — use `Ink(decoration:)`.

instruction: Terangkan `rebuild relayout repaint` dalam satu minit.
output: Flutter pipeline: rebuild (widget!) -> relayout (render!) -> repaint (paint!) (!) — `setState` alone triggers rebuild subtree, `RepaintBoundary` isolates paint, `const` widgets stop rebuild propagation early.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `sealed state ui pattern`?
output: `sealed class UiState { ... }` + `class Loading/Data/Error extends UiState` + exhaustive `switch` on state (!) — compiler forces every case (no forgotten error branch!), pattern from freezed unions.

instruction: Terangkan `inkwell ripple` dalam satu minit.
output: `InkWell(onTap:!, child: Padding(...))` gives Material ripple + splash (!) — needs a `Material` ancestor (inside `Card`/`Scaffold` ok!); `Ink` + `DecorationImage` when the ripple must paint over a background image.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `apk size reduce`?
output: `flutter build apk --split-per-abi --analyze-size` (!) — inspect `app-release.apk` composition (fonts! images! native libs!); defer heavy plugins, compress assets, avoid shipping all-density assets; `--wasm` for web.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `ongenerateroute dynamic`?
output: `onGenerateRoute: (settings) => MaterialPageRoute(...)` parses `settings.name` (`/user/7`!) (!) — `onUnknownRoute` catches typos; simpler than go_router for one-off dynamic routes, no deep-link support.

instruction: `hot reload vs restart` untuk apa?
output: Hot reload (`r`!) re-injects code keeping state (fast UI tweak!) — hot restart (`R`) resets state and re-runs `main` (!); neither re-runs `initState` on reload, so stashed flags survive unexpectedly.

instruction: What is `fix ios pod error silicon` for?
output: `ffi`/old pods fail on Apple Silicon (!) — `sudo arch -x86_64 pod install` or add `post_install` fixing deployment targets/`EXCLUDED_ARCHS` (!); CocoaPods version and Xcode CLT mismatch are other classics.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `materialpageroute transition`.
output: `MaterialPageRoute` gives platform transitions (`fullscreenDialog: true` slide-up for modals!) — custom motion needs `PageRouteBuilder` (`transitionsBuilder`! `transitionDuration`!) or `Hero` for shared-element jumps.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `fix correct dark mode testing suite`?
output: Dark bugs invisible in light testing (!) — run widget tests with `themeMode` overridden, golden both modes, and check `Colors.white` literals with a grep (!) in review.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `fix nested scroll conflict`.
output: Two scrollables fight for gestures (!) — inner `ListView` inside outer `SingleChildScrollView` needs `physics: NeverScrollableScrollPhysics()` + `shrinkWrap`, or better: `CustomScrollView` + slivers (one scrollable owns everything!).

instruction: What problem does `fix gradle daemon memory` solve?
output: `OutOfMemoryError: Metaspace`/daemon dies on big builds (!) — raise in `android/gradle.properties`: `org.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4g -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=1g` (!) and optionally `org.gradle.daemon=false` in CI.

instruction: Give a practical example of `permission handler ask`.
output: `Permission.camera.request()` returns `PermissionStatus` (!) — branch granted/denied/permanentlyDenied and `openAppSettings()` for the last; declare usage strings in `Info.plist`/`AndroidManifest` or iOS crashes on request.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `fcm notification handle`.
output: `FirebaseMessaging.onMessage.listen(...)` (foreground!) + `onMessageOpenedApp` (tap!) + `getInitialMessage()` (cold start!) (!) — request `NotificationSettings`, show local notification for foreground on Android (FCM does not).

instruction: Bila perlu guna `cocoapods pod install`?
output: iOS build failures (`Podfile.lock` drift!) -> `cd ios && pod repo update && pod install` (!) — Apple Silicon needs `arch -x86_64 pod install` for some old pods; commit the Podfile, gitignore the Pods folder.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `darktheme modedark`.
output: `MaterialApp(theme: ..., darkTheme: ThemeData.dark(), themeMode: ThemeMode.system)` (!) — `system` follows OS, `dark`/`light` force; `ThemeMode` swaps the whole `ThemeData`, so test both early.

instruction: What does `equatable equality` do?
output: `class User extends Equatable { @override List<Object?> get props => [id, name]; }` (!) — without value equality, `BlocBuilder` and `setState` diffing treat equal states as changed (extra rebuilds!) or vice versa.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `bottomsheet showmodal`.
output: `showModalBottomSheet` (drag-dismiss! `isScrollControlled: true` for tall sheets!) vs persistent `Scaffold.bottomSheet` (!) — `showSnackBar` style feedback belongs to `ScaffoldMessenger`, not the sheet.

instruction: Give a practical example of `fix jank on scroll`.
output: Scroll jank even in profile mode (!) — usuals: decoding big images (set `cacheWidth`!), heavy `itemBuilder` (precompute!), `Opacity` widgets (use `AnimatedOpacity`/`FadeTransition` — `Opacity` costs like an offscreen pass!), `MediaQuery.of` in item builders.

instruction: Give a practical example of `keys global vs value`.
output: `ValueKey(id)` tells Flutter which list items are the same across rebuilds (! reorder animation correct!) — `GlobalKey` (single widget! survives reparent!) reaches a widget's state (`key.currentState!`) used sparingly (! it disables some optimizations).

instruction: Bila perlu guna `scaffold appbar body fab`?
output: `Scaffold` gives the page skeleton (`appBar`! `body`! `floatingActionButton`! `bottomNavigationBar`! `drawer`!) — one per route; `Scaffold.of(context)` reaches the nearest one (! context must be below!).

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `hive local db`?
output: `await Hive.initFlutter(); await Hive.openBox('settings');` then `box.put('key', value)` (!) — synchronous reads after open, adapters for typed objects; fast for caches/settings, no queries across boxes.

instruction: When do I use `bottomnavigationbar pages`?
output: `BottomNavigationBar` + `IndexedStack` (keeps page state!) = classic tab shell — `currentIndex`! `onTap: (i) => setState(...)` (!); `NavigationBar` is the Material 3 replacement with `NavigationDestination`.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `datepicker showdatepicker`?
output: `showDatePicker(context:!, initialDate:!, firstDate: DateTime(2000), lastDate: DateTime(2100))` returns `Future<DateTime?>` (!) — format for display with `intl` `DateFormat('dd/MM/yyyy')` (`initializeDateFormatting` for locales!).

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `golden tests`?
output: `matchesGoldenFile('goldens/card.png')` pixel-compares widgets (!) — render with a deterministic font (Ahem/`golden_toolkit`) or text antialiasing flaps the diff; run `--update-goldens` on intentional changes.

instruction: `model fromjson factory` untuk apa?
output: `factory User.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> j) => User(id: j['id'] as int, name: j['name'] as String)` (!) — null-safe casts (`as String?`) or `json['x'] ?? default` prevent runtime type crashes from API drift.

instruction: What does `fix missingplugin exception` do?
output: `MissingPluginException` after adding a plugin (!) — stop and re-run (`flutter run` hot-restart does not register new plugins!) — also check the plugin supports the platform (web/desktop gaps!).

instruction: Terangkan `fix tabbar length mismatch` secara ringkas.
output: `Controller's length property does not match the number of tabs` (!) — `DefaultTabController(length: n)`/`TabController(length: n)` must equal `tabs.length` AND `TabBarView.children.length` (!) — the classic off-by-one after adding a tab.

instruction: Terangkan `async await ui thread` dalam satu minit.
output: `async`/`await` keeps the UI thread free (no blocking!) — work still runs on the event loop, so CPU-heavy loops love to jank (!); `await` inside `setState` needs the `mounted` guard afterward.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `vibration haptics`?
output: `HapticFeedback.mediumImpact()`/`selectionClick()` for tasteful feedback (!) — `vibration` package for longer buzzes (needs VIBRATE permission!); respect user settings, overuse feels cheap.

instruction: Explain `http get json decode` briefly.
output: `http.get(Uri.parse(url))` -> `jsonDecode(res.body)` (!) — always check `res.statusCode == 200` first; set `headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}` on posts, and wrap in try/catch (`SocketException` offline!).

instruction: Bagaimanakah `launcher icons package` berfungsi?
output: `flutter_launcher_icons` (`flutter_launcher_icons.yaml` with 1024px source!) then `dart run flutter_launcher_icons` (!) — generates every mipmap/AppIcon size; `adaptive_icon_background` for Android 8+ masks.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `fix manifest merger failed`?
output: Merger conflicts (duplicate `android:label`! conflicting `minSdk`!) -> `tools:replace='android:label'`/`tools:node='merge'` in the app manifest (!) — or exclude the offending library attribute.

instruction: What is `lottie animations` for?
output: `Lottie.asset('assets/anim.json', controller: c, repeat: false)` (!) — After Effects JSON animations; `Lottie.network` for remote; heavy animations cost frames — prefer for empty states/success moments, not running forever.

instruction: What does `intl date number format` do?
output: `DateFormat.yMMMd(locale).format(date)`! `NumberFormat.currency(locale: 'ms_MY', symbol: 'RM')` (!) — init locales via `initializeDateFormatting('ms')` before first use or it throws at runtime.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `responsive layoutbuilder`?
output: `LayoutBuilder(builder: (_, c) => c.maxWidth > 600 ? Row(...) : Column(...))` (!) — adapts to the parent box, works in split-screen and tablets; `MediaQuery.sizeOf` only sees the whole window.

instruction: What problem does `fix dark mode invisible text` solve?
output: Hardcoded `Colors.black87` text vanishes on dark backgrounds (!) — use `Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onSurface` (!); `ThemeMode.system` testing on both modes early prevents the audit later.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `adaptive widgets ios`?
output: `Platform.isIOS ? CupertinoButton(...) : ElevatedButton(...)` or `switch` on `Theme.of(context).platform` (!) — real apps often just use Material on both (iOS users accept it!), Cupertino for the native feel.

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `desktop window build`.
output: `flutter config --enable-<linux/macos/windows>-desktop` then `flutter build windows` (!) — window sizing via `window_manager`/`window_size` plugins; CJK/menus/DPI need per-platform polish.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `webview_flutter basic`?
output: `WebViewController()..setJavaScriptMode(JavaScriptMode.unrestricted)..loadRequest(Uri.parse(url))` + `WebViewWidget(controller: c)` (!) — `NavigationDelegate` intercepts URLs; Android needs `INTERNET` permission.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `result of inherited model`?
output: `of(context)` looks up ancestors and registers dependency (`dependOnInheritedWidgetOfExactType`!) — that is why `Theme.of` rebuilds your widget on theme change (!); `getInheritedWidgetOfExactType` reads without subscribing.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `fix setstate during build`?
output: `setState() called during build` — you mutated state synchronously while building (!) — move logic to `initState`/post-frame (`WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback`!), or guard with `mounted` and listen to notifiers instead.

instruction: `freezed models` untuk apa?

output: `flutter config --enable-<linux/macos/windows>-desktop` then `flutter build windows` (!) — window sizing via `window_manager`/`window_size` plugins; CJK/menus/DPI need per-platform polish.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `tween animation value`?
output: `final a = Tween(begin: 0.0, end: 1.0).animate(CurvedAnimation(parent: ctrl, curve: Curves.easeOut))` (!) — drive anything with `AnimatedBuilder(animation: ctrl, builder:)`: sizes, colors, transforms.

instruction: Explain `mocktail mock` briefly.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `image picker camera gallery`.
output: `ImagePicker().pickImage(source: ImageSource.camera)` -> `XFile` (!) — on Android/iOS add camera/photo permissions in manifests; check `kIsWeb` for path vs bytes; compress via `imageQuality: 70`.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `statefulwidget setstate pair`?
output: `StatefulWidget` pairs with `State` (`createState()`) — `setState(() { ... })` marks dirty (!) and rebuilds the subtree; mutate fields inside the callback, never outside.

instruction: What problem does `pubspec assets declare` solve?
output: Assets must be listed (`flutter: assets: - assets/images/`!) — one folder line includes all files directly inside (!); forgot it and `Image.asset` throws `Unable to load asset` at runtime, not compile time.

instruction: Bagaimanakah `fix pub cache corrupt` berfungsi?
output: Weird compile errors from a half-downloaded package (!) — `flutter pub cache repair` (!) or delete `~/.pub-cache/hosted/pub.dev/<pkg>` and re-get; happens after aborted downloads/proxy issues.

instruction: What does `statelesswidget build immutable` do?
output: `StatelessWidget` (immutable! `build(BuildContext)`) redraws when parent/config changes — use for static UI (!); it never holds mutable state, so counters/forms need State.

instruction: `dependency overrides` untuk apa?
output: `dependency_overrides` force versions for pub conflicts (!) — avoids resolver deadlocks short-term, but pins silently drift; prefer upgrading both packages, remove overrides once merged upstream.

instruction: What problem does `audio just_audio` solve?
output: `AudioPlayer()..setUrl(url)..play()` with `player.positionStream`/`durationStream` (!) — `just_audio` ships gapless/playlists; combine with `audio_service` for lockscreen controls (foreground service permissions!).

instruction: How would you explain `flutter performance default` to a junior developer?
output: Perf defaults in order: `const` widgets, `ListView.builder`, sized images (`cacheWidth`), avoid `Opacity`/`ClipPath` in lists, defer heavy initial work (`scheduler` idle!) (!) — measure in `--profile` before and after any optimization.

instruction: What is `system overlay statusbar` for?
output: `SystemChrome.setSystemUIOverlayStyle(SystemUiOverlayStyle(statusBarColor: transparent, statusBarIconBrightness: dark))` (!) — `AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>` per screen is the declarative alternative; edge-to-edge needs `SafeArea`.

instruction: Terangkan `material3 dynamic color` dalam satu minit.
output: `ColorScheme.fromSeed(seedColor: brand)` + `useMaterial3: true` (!) — `dynamic_color` package pulls Android 12+ wallpaper palette; keep brand fallback for platforms without dynamic color.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `flutter doctor setup`?
output: `flutter doctor -v` diagnoses SDK/JDK/Android licenses/Xcode pods (!) — `flutter doctor --android-licenses` accepts SDK licenses; version pinning via `fvm` when teams need exact SDKs.

instruction: What does `didchangedependencies updatewidget` do?
output: `didChangeDependencies` runs after `initState` and when `InheritedWidget` deps change (!) — `didUpdateWidget(old)` fires when the parent rebuilds with new config; both are safe places to react, not to call `setState` synchronously in build.

instruction: Apa yang perlu saya tahu tentang `image caching precache`?
output: `precacheImage` warms the cache before the route shows (!) — avoids first-frame flash; `Image.network(..., cacheWidth: 400)` decodes downsampled, saving memory for thumbnails (!).

instruction: Explain `stack positioned overlay` briefly.
output: `Stack` layers children (`Positioned(left/top/right/bottom)`!) — later children paint on top (!); un-positioned children align via `alignment` (`Alignment.bottomRight`!), `clipBehavior` controls overflow paint.

instruction: Give a real-world scenario for `fix internet permission`.
output: Network `SocketException` on Android release but works in debug = missing `INTERNET` permission (!) — add it to `AndroidManifest.xml`; debug builds merge it automatically, which masks the bug until release.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `fix safearea double padding`?
output: Double gaps (status bar space twice!) = `SafeArea` + `AppBar` both padding, or SafeArea inside SafeArea (!) — `SafeArea(top: false)` when an app bar handles it (!); `MediaQuery.removePadding` when a package already consumed it.

instruction: Explain `animatedbuilder scope` briefly.
output: `AnimatedBuilder` rebuilds only its subtree per tick (!) — put the changing subtree inside, keep `child:` static parts passed through (perf!); for simple fades `FadeTransition(opacity: a)` skips even that.

instruction: How would you explain `version build number` to a junior developer?
output: `pubspec.yaml`: `version: 1.2.3+45` -> Android versionName/versionCode, iOS CFBundleShortVersionString/Build (!) — build number MUST increase per store upload; `--build-name`/`--build-number` override at build time.

instruction: When do I use `fix animationcontroller vsync`?
output: `AnimationController` throws without a `TickerProvider` (!) — mix in `SingleTickerProviderStateMixin` (one controller!) / `TickerProviderStateMixin` (many!); `vsync: this` typo = compile error with hints.

instruction: Bilakah masa yang sesuai untuk `fix permissions permanently denied`?
output: `request()` returns `permanentlyDenied` and the dialog never shows again (!) — route the user to `openAppSettings()` (!); explain WHY before sending them to settings (store reviewers reject blind redirects!).

instruction: What does `card listtile` do?
output: `Card(child: ListTile(leading:!, title:!, subtitle:!, trailing:!, onTap:!))` is the Material list idiom (!) — `ListTile.divideTiles`/`ListView.separated` draw separators; `Card` takes `elevation`/`shape`.

instruction: Bagaimanakah `safearea notches` berfungsi?
output: `SafeArea` pads content away from notches/status bar/home indicator (!) — `SafeArea(top: false)` only when an `AppBar` already handles the top; `MediaQuery.paddingOf(context)` for manual math.

instruction: Terangkan `deeplink applinks` dalam satu minit.
output: Android `intent-filter` (autoVerify! `android:scheme='https'`) + iOS `associated-domains` + `app_links`/`uni_links` stream (!) — without server `assetlinks.json`/`apple-app-site-association` the link opens the browser instead.

instruction: How would you explain `scream test widget` to a junior developer?

instruction: Explain `dropdownbutton items` briefly.
output: `DropdownButton<T>` (`value`! `items: [DropdownMenuItem(value: v, child: Text(t))]`! `onChanged`) — unique values or Flutter asserts (!); `DropdownButtonFormField` plugs straight into `Form` validation.

instruction: Apakah fungsi `fix tap not working`?
output: Invisible layer steals taps (!) — `Stack` overlay with full-size `Container`, or `GestureDetector` with transparent child (no hit area!) (!) — `behavior: HitTestBehavior.opaque`, or `IgnorePointer` on decorative overlays.

instruction: Bila perlu guna `inkwell ripple`?
output: `InkWell(onTap:!, child: Padding(...))` gives Material ripple + splash (!) — needs a `Material` ancestor (inside `Card`/`Scaffold` ok!); `Ink` + `DecorationImage` when the ripple must paint over a background image.

instruction: Terangkan `materialpageroute transition` secara ringkas.
output: `MaterialPageRoute` gives platform transitions (`fullscreenDialog: true` slide-up for modals!) — custom motion needs `PageRouteBuilder` (`transitionsBuilder`! `transitionDuration`!) or `Hero` for shared-element jumps.

instruction: Terangkan `flutter build apk release` secara ringkas.
output: `flutter build apk --release` outputs `build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk` (!) — debug banner and asserts stripped; `--split-per-abi` builds arm64-v8a/armeabi-v7a separately (smaller downloads! Play wants AAB anyway).

instruction: Beri contoh penggunaan `version build number`.
output: `pubspec.yaml`: `version: 1.2.3+45` -> Android versionName/versionCode, iOS CFBundleShortVersionString/Build (!) — build number MUST increase per store upload; `--build-name`/`--build-number` override at build time.

instruction: Give a practical example of `http post form json`.
output: `http.post(url, headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, body: jsonEncode({...}))` (!) — for form-encoded use `body: {'a': '1'}` without the header (http encodes automatically); decode with `utf8.decode(res.bodyBytes)` for Malay accents (!).

instruction: `image decode size` untuk apa?
output: `Image.network(url, cacheWidth: (400 * dpr).round())` decodes at display size (!) — a 4000px photo decoded full is ~48MB RAM; server-side thumbnails or `ResizeImage` avoid OOM on lists.
